description: Source code for the ta_management_system class and related UE timing advance management functions in a 3GPP LTE/5G scheduler context.

classes.name: ta_management_system
classes.description: Manages timing advance for UEs, including adding/removing UEs, handling slot indications, and processing TA updates.

classes.name: ue_ta_manager
classes.description: Manages individual UE's timing advance state and resets.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context with specified parameters and updates tags.

methods.name: rem_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from the time wheel and repository.

methods.name: slot_indication
methods.description: Processes slot indication, advances the time wheel, and handles pending TA commands.

methods.name: handle_ue_ta_cmds
methods.description: Handles pending TA commands for a UE, sending MAC indications if needed.

methods.name: update_tags
methods.description: Updates the timing advance reports for a UE with new tag IDs.

methods.name: compute_new_t_a
methods.description: Calculates a new timing advance value based on the difference and subcarrier spacing.

methods.name: compute_avg_n_ta_difference
methods.description: Computes the average N_TA difference from report data.

methods.name: handle_ul_n_ta_update_indication
methods.description: Processes uplink N_TA update indications, filtering out low SINR and outliers, updating statistics, and scheduling TA commands.

methods.name: is_outlier
methods.description: Determines if a sample is an outlier based on Welford's algorithm and a z-score threshold.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the ue_ta_manager, removing the UE from parent management.
